findings.summary: Anti-gameability guard heuristic not exhaustive: the inspection test's anti-gameability mechanism relies on a heuristic count of borrow patterns rather than a semantic proof that exactly one logical borrow path exists; an adversary with knowledge of the heuristic could construct a non-obvious two-borrow pattern that collapses to a single grep hit
findings.resolution_route: NO_ACTION — ruling upheld after Pass-6 re-audit; heuristic plus companion structural tests provide adequate layered defense for this risk level; the theoretical attack surface requires deeper refactor than warranted by LOW severity OBSERVATION

findings.summary: Test module docstring missing 5th enforced invariant: the docstring for the borrow-budget annotation test module enumerated 4 enforced invariants but the test actually enforces 5 (the 5th being that the doc-paragraph marker region is excluded from the body-site count); the omission would mislead future maintainers about what the test verifies
findings.resolution_route: FIXED — doc-only update at 2418048 adds the 5th invariant to the test module docstring; no code change
